title: Eric DeCosta: Ravens wanted Maxx Crosby, "gutted" that he failed physical

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Eric DeCosta: Ravens wanted Maxx Crosby, "gutted" that he failed physical
sources.description: "I've got a responsibility to the Ravens," DeCosta said. "I understand how people from afar would feel that way, but nobody's more upset about this than me."
